home.title: Patika React Apps
home.subtitle: Applications developed within the Patika.dev Front-End bootcamp
home.weather_desc: Real-time weather for 81 cities in Turkey. Temperature, humidity, feels-like and weather conditions.
home.rickmorty_desc: List all Rick and Morty characters using the GraphQL API, search by name and filter by status, gender, species and location.
home.bmi_desc: Enter your height and weight to calculate your Body Mass Index and receive personalised diet recommendations.
home.shop_desc: Explore our clothing collection. Add to cart, save favourites and follow the season's latest trends.
home.notes_desc: A Notion-style notes app. Create, edit, delete and pin notes — everything is saved in your browser automatically.
home.chat_desc: Real-time chat application. Multiple users can message each other simultaneously. Instant multi-user communication via Socket.io.
home.crypto_desc: Live cryptocurrency prices via CoinGecko API. Browse the top 100 coins, search by name and track market data.
home.memory_desc: A 4x3 memory card game. Find all matching pairs in the fewest moves and save your best score to localStorage.
home.books_desc: Search books and authors using the Google Books API. Browse cover images and open a detail modal for page count, publish date and more.
home.rps_desc: Play Rock Paper Scissors against the computer! Win a round +1, lose -1. First to ±3 wins. Round history is displayed.

bmi.calc_sub: Enter your height and weight to calculate your Body Mass Index.
bmi.invalid_input: Please enter a valid height (50–250 cm) and weight (10–500 kg).
bmi.no_result: No calculation has been made yet.
bmi.diet_summary_underweight: Your BMI is below normal. Focus on high-calorie, protein-rich foods to gain weight in a healthy way.
bmi.diet_summary_normal: Congratulations! You are in a healthy BMI range. Follow the recommended diet to maintain this balance.
bmi.diet_summary_overweight: Your BMI is above normal. You can reach a healthy weight by adjusting your calorie intake and exercising.
bmi.diet_summary_obese: Your BMI is high. It is strongly recommended to consult a doctor or dietitian and make significant lifestyle changes.
bmi.diet_underweight_1: High-protein foods: eggs, chicken, fish, legumes
bmi.diet_underweight_2: Healthy fats: avocado, nuts, olive oil, peanut butter
bmi.diet_underweight_3: Complex carbs: oats, brown rice, whole wheat bread
bmi.diet_underweight_5: Eat 5–6 meals a day to increase your caloric intake
bmi.diet_normal_1: Balanced diet including all food groups
bmi.diet_normal_2: Plenty of vegetables and fruit with every meal
bmi.diet_normal_3: Drink at least 8 glasses of water per day
bmi.diet_normal_4: Lean protein sources: chicken breast, turkey, fish
bmi.diet_normal_5: Watch portion sizes and avoid processed foods
bmi.diet_overweight_1: Aim to reduce daily caloric intake by 500 kcal
bmi.diet_overweight_2: Include plenty of greens and salad in every meal
bmi.diet_overweight_3: Avoid fizzy drinks and sugary foods
bmi.diet_overweight_4: Prefer lean proteins: chicken breast, turkey, fish
bmi.diet_overweight_5: Increase physical activity with regular walks and light exercise
bmi.diet_obese_1: Seek professional support from a doctor or dietitian
bmi.diet_obese_2: Significantly reduce ultra-processed food and fast food
bmi.diet_obese_3: Choose high-fiber foods: vegetables, legumes, whole grains
bmi.diet_obese_4: Do not skip meals; eat at regular times
bmi.diet_obese_5: Start with gentle activity like walking and gradually increase intensity
bmi.info_intro: Body Mass Index (BMI) is a value obtained by dividing a person's weight by the square of their height. It is a practical measure used to assess general health status.
bmi.info_note: Note: BMI alone does not fully reflect your health status. Factors such as age, gender, muscle mass and bone density should also be considered. Consult a health professional for a definitive assessment.
bmi.history_empty: No calculation history yet. It will appear here after you make a calculation.
